stations.title: Odile
stations.note: A cafe says one never came.

captions: A cafe says an October delivery never came, and Odile needs the delivery log.
An order only says cafe 9 and driver 3. That means nothing on the phone.
You write queries that bring tables together, in three tasks.
Now the October log shows each cafe and driver by name.
Same orders, read across tables. Ids turn back into names.
